2. **Pine Crossing (store):** Pree's message from Jun 9 2026. The morning receiver can only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen.
3. **Wichita (store):** Pree's message from Jul 2 2025. It mentions the "Wichita store dispatcher" alongside the Marrow office-hours link, but never says the store is Marrow's. I told Pree to treat it as likely, not confirmed.

I left out the Tulsa hub because it belongs to Tansley Parcel. I also told Pree that Hollis's Jun 9 message says three rows on the tracker just read "waiting", but the channel doesn't name any other stores.

The knowledge-brain search only ran in keyword mode, so I didn't rely on it. I didn't use any channel Pree can't see.
